text:
toni: opened PR to tighten up rate-cap docs + add a small demo that shows how batching affects quota math. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2450

yusuf: Love the idea. Can we include a microbench script (python) that emits back-to-back requests so reviewers can see the batching smoothing effect in the dashboard?

toni: yes. I'll add tools/batch_demo.py and a 1-line run in the README: `python tools/batch_demo.py --tenant demo --qps 50 --duration 60`

clare: quick content notes: 1) clarify "rate cap" vs "rate limit" terminology in the intro, 2) show how token batching can make a single `request` incur many `billing_units`.

toni: reworded intro to define terms. example sentence: "rate cap = configured serving throughput; rate limit = per-route enforcement policy."

yusuf: include a short PromQL snippet for the smoothing panel, reviewers asked for exact queries: 

```promql
sum(rate(redwood_request_batch_size_sum[5m])) by (tenant)
```

clare: also add an SQL-ish generator for demo CSV so platform folks can import into local timeseries: 

```sql
-- generate 1h of synthetic usage, 1 sample per 10s
WITH seq AS (SELECT generate_series(0,359) AS i)
SELECT to_char((timestamp '2026-06-01 00:00:00' + (i*10) * interval '1 second') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS ts, 'demo' AS tenant, 'generate' as route, (random()*150 + 50)::int AS tokens
FROM seq;
```

toni: added a compact CSV example (10 rows) and a one-liner sqlite import. also included note: "timestamps must be ISO8601 UTC; Grafana import uses dashboard timezone settings."

yusuf: we should add SDK header samples for node/python/java. folks keep using the older `X-Redwood-Quota` header. include migration alias and a tiny jq conversion: 

```bash
# convert old header string to new meter header
old='tenant=demo;units=512;timestamp=2026-06-01T00:00:00Z'
echo "$old" | jq -R 'split(";") | map(split("=") | { (.[0]): .[1] }) | add'
```

clare: small UX nit on the PromQL: change panel label to "Batch size (5m avg)" and add right-axis for burst credits metric: `redwood_burst_credit_balance{tenant="demo"}` so reviewers don't misread negative dips.

toni: done. added grafana import link in PR description and the small panel JSON for quick import: https://grafana.example.com/d/import/klmn1234

eng-ops: FYI, in dedicated we do additional server-side batching which will make the demo produce slightly different spectra; added a short paragraph noting differences across Hosted/Dedicated/Private.

yusuf: perfect. also include a tiny troubleshooting FAQ: "My usage graph shows periodic spikes but billing looks smooth" -> answer: spikes are ingestion latency artifacts or delayed joins; check `redwood_usage_ingest_delay_seconds` and the raw CSV timestamps.

clare: can we add a one-line smoke test to confirm metrics are exposed locally? `curl -s http://localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=up | jq .`

docs-bot: preview build started for PR #2450 (linkcheck, lint)

toni: merging after green checks. will follow up with translations (es/fr) and a shorter "quickstart" card for the console docs.

docs-bot: PR #2450 merged by toni. release note: "rate-cap docs: batching demo, SDK header migration, PromQL & Grafana import"
